payload.rationale: Hard-gate id_integrity failures cannot be repaired within this role’s constraints. Fixing milestone deliverable IDs to the required DL# family would require changing existing "/id" values under /plan_package/milestones/*/deliverables/*/id, which is explicitly forbidden (MUST NOT change any existing "/id" values). Additionally, the validator flags architecture option risk linkage issues under /plan_package/architecture/options (a locked canonical section), and at least one missing acceptance-test coverage issue would require minting a new AT# (forbidden: MUST NOT add to /acceptance_tests). These items require reroute to the appropriate owner to perform ID-family remediation and any necessary canonical-section updates.
